stem_book: Consider the following four elements, which are represented according to the long form of periodic table (Y directly above X; W to the left and Z to the right of X). Here W, Y and Z are left, up and right elements with respect to the element 'X', and 'X' belongs to the 16th group and 3rd period. Then according to given information the incorrect statement regarding given elements is: (a) Maximum electronegativity : Y (b) Maximum catenation property : X (c) Maximum electron affinity : Z (d) Y exhibits variable covalency
work: X = S, Y = O, W = P, Z = Cl; O (EN 3.5) max EN ✓, S max catenation ✓, Cl max EA ✓; O has no d-orbitals → no variable covalency, (d) incorrect
